articles.title: Bitcoin Tops $80,000 for First Time Since May as Dollar Weakens on Treasury Buyback Plans
articles.excerpt: The cryptocurrency has rallied 28% in August, its best month since November 2024, as investors pile into the debasement trade amid growing U.S. fiscal concerns.
articles.image_caption: A representation of Bitcoin. The cryptocurrency topped $80,000 for the first time since May as the U.S. dollar weakened on Treasury buyback plans.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Sugar Market Swings From Surplus to Shortage as Prices Hit Record Ahead of Festivals
articles.excerpt: What began as a season of oversupply and falling prices has turned into a scramble to contain record sugar costs, forcing New Delhi to allow imports for the first time in nearly a decade.
articles.image_caption: YouTube / India Today
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex, Nifty Reverse Intraday Losses to Close Higher as Crude Oil Falls 3%
articles.excerpt: Indian benchmarks recovered from early-session weakness as oil dropped to a one-week low, while the first monthly Nifty derivatives expiry under the new closing auction system drove sharp late-session swings.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai. The Sensex and Nifty reversed intraday losses to close higher as crude oil prices fell sharply.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Government Readies Hindustan Zinc Stake Sale to Raise Rs 5,000 Crore in Disinvestment Push
articles.excerpt: The Centre plans to sell up to 2% of its holding in India's largest zinc producer through an offer for sale, building on a renewed drive to meet fiscal targets.
articles.nri_angle: The HZL stake sale offers a window into India's evolving approach to public sector disinvestment and opportunities NRI investors in Indian equities should watch.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Plans First Tokenised Bond Issue in September Using Blockchain Settlement
articles.excerpt: State-owned power financier REC will issue blockchain-settled corporate bonds worth up to $57 million, placing India alongside Europe and Hong Kong in digital securities innovation.
articles.image_caption: India plans to issue its first tokenised government bond in September 2026, using blockchain technology for settlement in a pilot led by the Reserve Bank of India.
articles.nri_angle: India's tokenised bond pilot signals a modernizing financial market that could eventually offer faster, more transparent investment access for NRI investors.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: L&T Wins Third Ultra-Mega Middle East Gas Project Worth Over 15,000 Crore in August
articles.excerpt: The gas compression contract is Larsen and Toubro's third order exceeding 15,000 crore rupees this month, reinforcing the Indian engineering giant's dominance in Gulf energy infrastructure.
articles.image_caption: Larsen and Toubro has secured its third ultra-mega hydrocarbon project in the Middle East in August 2026, with the latest gas compression contract valued at over Rs 15,000 crore.
articles.nri_angle: L&T's expanding Middle East presence highlights Indian engineering firms' growing global footprint, relevant to NRI investors and professionals in the Gulf energy sector.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: SEBI Rejects Settlement Bids by Adani-Linked Offshore Funds, Escalating Regulatory Standoff
articles.excerpt: India’s markets regulator turns down at least three Mauritius-based funds’ applications to settle disclosure violations, setting the stage for formal enforcement proceedings.
articles.image_caption: The Securities and Exchange Board of India headquarters in Mumbai. SEBI has rejected consent settlement applications from two Adani-linked offshore funds, escalating its regulatory investigation into alleged share price manipulation.
articles.nri_angle: SEBI’s handling of Adani-linked offshore funds has direct implications for foreign portfolio investors, including NRI-backed funds operating in Indian markets.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Third Wave Coffee Raises Rs 408 Crore as WestBridge Capital Doubles Down on India’s Cafe Boom
articles.excerpt: Bengaluru-based coffee chain secures fresh funding from existing backers at a valuation of up to $500 million, nearly tripling its 2023 valuation as India’s specialty coffee market heats up.
articles.image_caption: Third Wave Coffee, one of India's fastest-growing specialty cafe chains, has raised Rs 408 crore in a funding round led by WestBridge Capital.
articles.nri_angle: India’s booming specialty coffee market presents investment opportunities for diaspora investors tracking the country’s consumer spending growth.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: The 55-25-20 Portfolio: How Adding Equity and Gold to Debt Nearly Doubled Returns Over 25 Years
articles.excerpt: A WhiteOak Capital study of rolling returns from 2001 to 2026 finds that mixing debt, equity, and gold can boost returns by 5 percentage points with barely any extra volatility.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors balancing portfolios across India and their country of residence can use these data-backed allocation frameworks to optimise risk-adjusted returns across multiple asset classes.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Augmont Enterprises IPO Opens With 38% Grey Market Premium as Gold Platform Eyes ₹825 Crore
articles.excerpt: India's integrated gold and silver platform Augmont Enterprises kicks off its three-day IPO at ₹750-788 per share, with strong anchor investor backing and bullish broker ratings.
articles.nri_angle: Augmont's IPO offers NRI investors a rare listed play on India's gold digitalisation trend as the precious metals market formalises.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: BSE Shares Slide as NSE Plans to Allow Trading of Its Own Stock After Listing
articles.excerpt: Bloomberg reports NSE may permit its shares to trade on its own platform, potentially shifting volumes and reshaping the competitive dynamics between Indias two largest exchanges.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai, Indias oldest stock exchange. BSE shares declined after reports that rival NSE plans to allow trading of its own stock on its platform.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors with Indian equity portfolios are closely watching the exchange battle, as the outcome affects liquidity, trading costs, and index composition for their holdings.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: SEBI Chief Tells Mutual Fund Industry to Measure Success by Investor Outcomes, Not AUM
articles.excerpt: At AMFIs 31st Foundation Day, Chairman Pandey set a target of doubling Indias mutual fund investor base to 12 crore and urged a shift from asset accumulation to investor returns.
articles.image_caption: Image: @SEBI_India via X
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors with mutual fund holdings in India stand to benefit from SEBIs push for outcome-focused metrics and simplified cross-border investing through platforms like GIFT City.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wall Street Eyes 9% Dividend Yields as Income Investors Hunt for Retirement Cash Flow
articles.excerpt: Business development companies and legacy dividend payers are delivering yields above 9%, but analysts warn the risk-reward calculus demands careful scrutiny.
articles.image_caption: A trader monitors stock prices on multiple screens at a Wall Street trading desk. High-yield dividend strategies have gained traction as investors seek reliable income amid market uncertainty.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-American professionals building retirement portfolios in the U.S. are increasingly drawn to high-yield dividend strategies as a complement to traditional equity and real estate holdings.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Pays Above $23 per MMBtu for LNG as Iran War Drives Prices to Multi-Year Highs
articles.excerpt: GAIL India and Gujarat State Petroleum Corp. have purchased September delivery cargoes at the highest spot prices since 2022, as the Middle East conflict continues to disrupt global supply routes.
articles.image_caption: An LNG tanker at a gas terminal. India is paying above 3 per MMBtu for liquefied natural gas as the Iran conflict drives global prices to multi-year highs.
articles.nri_angle: Rising energy costs feed into India's broader inflation outlook, affecting household budgets, industrial competitiveness, and the investment environment that NRI investors are watching closely.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: JPMorgan Bets on India's Gold Loan Boom, Says Sector Could Double Its Share of Credit
articles.excerpt: The brokerage initiated overweight ratings on Muthoot Finance, Manappuram Finance, and IIFL Finance, calling gold loans a structural shift rather than a cyclical surge.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors tracking Indian financials now face a new sector thesis: gold-loan companies as structural growth plays, backed by the cultural shift in how Indian households use their largest non-financial asset.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Atomberg Technologies Files for IPO With ₹450 Crore Fresh Issue as Early Investors Head for Exit
articles.excerpt: The IIT-Bombay-founded smart appliance maker plans to list on Indian exchanges, with early backers including A91 Partners and Jungle Ventures selling shares through a 7.65 crore OFS.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building on Dalal Street in Mumbai. Atomberg Technologies has filed for an IPO with a ₹450 crore fresh issue.
articles.nri_angle: Atomberg, founded by IIT-Bombay alumni, represents the growing pipeline of Indian deep-tech startups heading for public markets, a trend NRI investors are watching closely.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Foreign Investor Flows Near Historic Lows as Jio BlackRock Flags Contrarian Opportunity in Indian Equities
articles.excerpt: FII holdings have dropped to a 14-year low of 15.88%, but the return of inflows in July and valuations at long-term averages suggest the worst may be over, a new report says.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange in Mumbai. Foreign portfolio investor flows into Indian equities have dropped to near historic lows, though Jio BlackRock sees a contrarian opportunity.
articles.nri_angle: Directly relevant to NRI investors with exposure to Indian equities through direct holdings, mutual funds, or NRE/NRO accounts
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Shein Slashes IPO Valuation to $25 Billion as Growth Stalls Ahead of Hong Kong Debut
articles.excerpt: The fast-fashion giant's planned listing values it at a quarter of its 2022 peak as tariffs, EU fees, and slowing sales erode investor confidence.
articles.image_caption: Shein, the Chinese-founded fast-fashion giant, has reportedly cut its IPO valuation target to around $25 billion ahead of a planned Hong Kong listing.
articles.nri_angle: Shein is one of the largest e-commerce platforms serving consumers globally, with its IPO offering a case study in how trade policy shifts impact cross-border retail
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Strategy's Bitcoin Holdings Swing to $1.4 Billion Gain After Five-Day Rally
articles.excerpt: The largest corporate Bitcoin holder flipped from a $13 billion unrealized loss to a gain as cryptocurrency surged 22% in five sessions.
articles.image_caption: Michael Saylor, executive chairman of Strategy, formerly MicroStrategy. The company's Bitcoin holdings have swung to a $1.4 billion unrealized gain after a five-day rally.
articles.nri_angle: Relevant to Indian-American investors tracking cryptocurrency and high-volatility tech equities
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Plans $1.2 Billion Incentive to Build Construction Equipment and Cut China Dependence
articles.excerpt: The seven-year scheme targets tunnel boring machines, elevators, and fire-fighting equipment — sectors where India remains heavily reliant on Chinese imports for metro rail and highway construction.
articles.image_caption: India has announced a .2 billion production-linked incentive to boost domestic construction equipment manufacturing and reduce dependence on Chinese imports.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian companies and NRI investors watching India's infrastructure buildout, the new scheme signals both an investment opportunity and an acknowledgment that previous manufacturing incentive approaches have fallen short.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Reports 29 FDI Investments Worth $511 Million Under Revised Land-Border Rules
articles.excerpt: The investments, spanning IT, AI, pharma, and manufacturing, offer the first evidence that a May policy easing approval requirements for firms with limited Chinese ownership is attracting capital.
articles.image_caption: India's commerce ministry has approved 29 foreign direct investment proposals worth $511 million under the country's revised land-border screening rules for investments from neighboring countries.
articles.nri_angle: NRI-linked funds and investment vehicles with incidental Chinese limited partner exposure now have a clearer path into Indian markets under the revised automatic route.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian Shares Post Weekly Losses as Oil Surge and Rising Bond Yields Weigh on Sentiment
articles.excerpt: Nifty and Sensex ended the week down 0.5-0.6% as Middle East crude price escalation and global bond market pressure kept investors cautious, though small-cap indices hit fresh 52-week highs.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai. Indian markets posted weekly losses as surging oil prices and rising bond yields weighed on investor sentiment.
articles.nri_angle: Rising crude and IT sector weakness are key concerns for NRI investors with exposure to Indian equities and the tech sector.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: ICICI Bank Doubles Overseas Borrowing Limit to $5 Billion as Indian Banks Race to Raise Dollars
articles.excerpt: India's second-largest private lender has already raised $2.05 billion in dollar debt this month and is negotiating a $1.45 billion syndicated loan, as the RBI's concessional swap window nears its August 31 deadline.
articles.image_caption: ICICI Bank, India's largest private-sector lender, has doubled its overseas borrowing limit to  billion as Indian banks race to raise dollar funding.
articles.nri_angle: The surge in Indian bank dollar fundraising reflects macro pressures on the rupee and the RBI's efforts to stabilize currency markets, factors that affect NRI remittances and deposit returns.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Gold Surges Past $4,500 After U.S. Treasury Doubles Bond Buybacks in Surprise Move
articles.excerpt: Spot gold jumps 3.6% to a two-and-a-half-month high as the dollar and long-dated yields tumble on the Treasury's liquidity support announcement.
articles.nri_angle: The gold rally and dollar weakness have direct implications for NRI investors and families with cross-border financial exposure.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Kotak Downgrades Infosys, TCS, and LTIMindtree as IT Stocks Slide on AI and Visa Concerns
articles.excerpt: The brokerage reverses its earlier buy ratings on India's top IT exporters, preferring mid-tier challengers as the Nifty IT index extends its 20%-plus decline in 2026.
articles.nri_angle: India'\''s IT sector is the economic backbone of the Indian professional diaspora in the United States, and downgrades to TCS and Infosys carry direct implications for H-1B workers, NRI investors, and the industry'\''s role as a gateway for immigration.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Skoda Launches Kylaq Sportline in India at Rs 11.32 Lakh
articles.excerpt: The new blacked-out variant slots between the Signature+ and Prestige trims of Skoda's bestselling sub-compact SUV.
articles.image_caption: YouTube / Khalid Anzar
articles.nri_angle: Indian auto market update — Skoda's sub-compact SUV segment growth in India relevant to NRIs tracking Indian markets and consumer trends.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Crypto Shares Surge as Treasury Doubles Buybacks, Trump Pushes Clarity Act
articles.excerpt: Bitcoin crossed $70,000 for the first time since June after the U.S. Treasury doubled long-duration debt buyback sizes, while Trump urged Congress to pass landmark crypto legislation.
articles.image_caption: Crypto-related stocks rallied sharply as the U.S. Treasury doubled its Bitcoin buyback program and a new regulatory clarity bill advanced in Congress.
articles.nri_angle: Global financial markets update — crypto and risk asset movements relevant to diaspora investors tracking U.S. markets
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: HDFC Bank Shares Rise as RBI Approves LIC Stake Hike to 9.99%
articles.excerpt: India's largest insurer can now more than double its holding in the country's biggest private-sector bank, with the approval valid for one year.
articles.image_caption: An HDFC Bank branch in India. The bank shares rose after the RBI approved LIC request to raise its stake to 9.99 percent.
articles.nri_angle: HDFC Bank is one of the most widely held Indian stocks among NRIs and trades as an ADR on NYSE; LIC's stake hike signals confidence at current valuations.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: RBI Governor Defends Early FCNR(B) Closure as Dollar Inflows Hit $80 Billion
articles.excerpt: Sanjay Malhotra calls the early window shutdown a calibrated, data-driven decision as NRI deposit inflows shatter the 2013 record and shore up India's balance of payments.
articles.image_caption: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra at an official event. Malhotra defended the early closure of FCNR(B) deposits as dollar inflows crossed $80 billion.
articles.nri_angle: FCNR(B) deposits are a key savings vehicle for NRIs; the RBI's concessional window drove record inflows but has now closed early.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Lowe's Cuts Full-Year Outlook as Cautious Homeowners Scale Back DIY Spending
articles.excerpt: The home-improvement retailer beat quarterly profit estimates but trimmed annual targets across the board, projecting flat comparable-store sales as budget-conscious consumers defer big-ticket renovations.
articles.image_caption: A Lowe's store location in the United States. The home-improvement retailer cut its full-year forecast after reporting weaker-than-expected quarterly results.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wall Street Rebounds as Treasury Yields Ease and Moderna Doubles on Cancer Data
articles.excerpt: U.S. stocks closed modestly higher Wednesday after the Treasury announced expanded buyback operations, cooling a bond-market selloff. Moderna shares more than doubled on promising melanoma vaccine trial results.
articles.image_caption: Traders work on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange. U.S. stocks rebounded on Wednesday as Treasury yields eased from recent highs.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
